messages:
kevin: Draft RN below — quick sanity check? planning to send internal announcement tomorrow 10:30 PT. also need a pin and deploybot cue. snippet: "Release 2026-03-23 — Redwood API: improved small-sequence batching and KV cache warmup; ~12% p95 tail reduction; fix for rare memory cliff on long context. Dedicated customers: routed fallback remains v2026-02-10 for 24h." link: <https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-23>

lina: :eyes: quick asks — can we add explicit rollback criteria + canary length? otherwise looks good. also sales blurb needed.

marco: ops note — suggested rollback triggers: error rate spike >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regression >20% vs baseline. canary length = 2h with 10% traffic initial -> 50% after smoke pass. who is oncall during rollout window?

jess: i'm oncall tomorrow 09-17 PT, i'll own watch and escalate. +1 for 2h canary. i can also page infra if we see OOM patterns.

kevin: thanks — updating RN. quick question: do we pin the internal announce message or pin a separate 'standby + rollback' doc? i think pin the announce and the runbook link.

jen-oncall: pin both. small checklist we use in past releases: owner (comm): @lina, oncall: @jess, runtime lead: @marco. comms channel: #eng-releases + #oncall-ops. add a short one-line rollback instruction in the RN.

lina: i'll be comms owner. kevin, send me final RN by EOD and i'll prep a short heads-up for sales and AE leads.

kevin: deploying draft update now. deploy-bot: please queue canary for release-2026-03-23 and leave a deploy cue in channel.

deploy-bot: queued canary: release-2026-03-23 -> canary pool scheduled 2026-03-23T09:30:00 PT. to trigger manually:
```
/deploy release-2026-03-23 --canary 2h --traffic 10%
```
Rollback command (manual):
```
/rollback release-2026-03-23 --target old-2026-02-10
```
Links: metrics dashboard <https://dashboards.internal/releases/release-2026-03-23> | runbook <https://runbooks.internal/release-2026-03-23-runbook>

marco: added rollback criteria to runbook (line items). make sure the canary pool uses same hw profile as prod (g4x-2). i'll be ready to promote fallback if needed.

kevin: request pin: @deploy-bot please pin message id:release-2026-03-23-announce to #eng-releases and attach runbook link.

deploy-bot: pinned message in #eng-releases (pin_id: 987654321). deploy cue visible.

jess: i'll add a short monitoring checklist to the runbook (alerts to watch, quick queries). will post when done. :thumbsup:

lina: thanks everyone — i'll draft the sales blurb after kevin sends final RN. kevin pls confirm once you post final copy.

kevin: final RN posted and pinned. thanks all for quick turns. i'll drop a short digest to #all-hands tomorrow after we verify canary. last note: if anything looks off, rollback threshold described above -> @marco will trigger. done.
